compute_ocr_rects: compute the optimum amount and coordinates of rectangles to OCR on a given page
filter_ocr_cells: filter OCR cells by dropping any OCR cell that intersects with an existing programmatic cell
post_process_cells: post-process the OCR cells and update the page object with combined textline cells
combine_cells: combine existing and OCR cells with overlap filtering and re-indexing
draw_ocr_rects_and_cells: draw OCR rectangles and cells onto a page image for debugging visualization
